item.title: Welcome
item.description: I used to think there were two types of subjects: "humanistic" and STEM.
item.content:encoded:
I used to think there were two types of subjects: "humanistic" and STEM. Humanistic subjects studied human endeavours such as history, law, literature, languages. These subject I thought were, in a sense, completely arbitatrary.

Now that I grew up in the industry I see that every STEM subjects is and will always be about people. And people value clever technical ingenuity, as well as clear cut communication. Aestethics and communication are an integral part of every technological endeavour.
